annotations.title: Find the same records in other systems

description: AI Agents (inside one system): Use for questions across systems, such as which won deals have no invoice in the books yet or which contact is which customer: for up to 50 records of one system it returns the same records in the customer's other systems, as their CRM Connector syncs link them, with the record type each became there. A copy in another system connected to AI Agents can then be read with get_record. Only systems CRM Connector syncs with each other know their shared records. Not for what a record is linked to inside one system (use list_related_records).

ids.description: The ids of the records, at most 50.

system.description: Which AI agent: the system's id from get_ai_agents_info, or the name of the system or its connection. Ask the person which AI agent they mean unless they named it in this conversation; never pick one yourself.

type.description: The record type, as get_ai_agents_info lists it: contact, opportunity, invoice, estimate, job, appointment.

name: find_linked_records
title: Find the same records in other systems
